headline: The AI Researcher Who Just Quit Anthropic Says It’s ‘Crunch Time for Humanity’
context: Jacob Coxon talks to WIRED about the “mini Manhattan project” inside Anthropic, the problem with alignment, and why AI labs have just a few years left to make their systems safe.
